subject: Temporary burst addendum & pricing concession for Nimbus Retail campaign
messages:
From: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@nimblestore.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Upcoming holiday campaign — short window capacity request

Ben,

We have a holiday push scheduled for June 10–12 and expect a spike in conversational traffic for our in-app assistant. Preliminary traffic modeling shows a potential 2.5x increase in tokens/minute during peak hours (approx. 18:00–22:00 PST each day). We tried to absorb this in our baseline, but we need short-term headroom to avoid degraded UX.

Can Redwood provide a short-window quota increase (72 hours) and what would the pricing look like? Procurement will need an estimate for budgeting — PO + net-30 is preferred. Also, if we agree to a short-term fee, would you consider any concession on per-token overage or a discount if we commit to extra monthly capacity afterwards?

Attaching our initial traffic deck.

Thanks,
Sofia Ramos
Head of Product, Nimbus Retail
[attachment: map_nimbus_campaign.pdf]
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@nimblestore.com>
Cc: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimblestore.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming holiday campaign — short window capacity request

Hi Sofia — great timing, congrats on lining this up. Short answer: yes, we can support a 72-hour burst with a short addendum. Here are two practical options to consider based on similar launches we've supported: 

1) Short-window burst add-on (recommended)
  - Capacity: temporary +2x baseline throughput for a contiguous 72-hour window
  - Cost: flat activation fee $14,500 (one-time) + standard per-token billing during the window
  - Overrun protection: after the flat window, additional overage billed at $0.0009/token
  - Discount: 20% off the overage rate if Nimbus signs a 3-month committed uplift within 30 days of the burst

2) Metered headroom (no flat fee)
  - Capacity increases automatically while we invoice per-token at $0.0012/token during the event
  - No upfront commitment, higher per-token rate

I attached a short pricing sheet and a draft addendum you can share with procurement. If PO + net-30 is required we can accommodate — we just need an invoice contact and a billing address.

Next steps: if option 1 looks good, I can draft the amendment and send a DocuSign link. If you want to negotiate the flat fee or discount, let me know your target and I’ll route for approval.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
[attachment: burst_pricing_sheet_v2.xlsx] [attachment: amendment_short_window.docx]
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimblestore.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@nimblestore.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Upcoming holiday campaign — short window capacity request

Ben — thanks for the clear options. A couple of quick asks from procurement and finance: 

- Can you reduce the flat activation fee to $9,500? That keeps the event within our campaign budget.
- If we take the 20% overage discount, can we get the commitment window down to 2 months instead of 3? 3 months is a hard ask for the team right now.
- We need the legal amendment to include a throttling fallback clause describing how Redwood will handle sustained excess beyond the burst window so our ops team can prepare for degraded responses.

If you can get close to the $9.5k activation fee and a 15–20% discount with a 2-month uplift commitment, we can route a PO quickly. Please send a DocuSign link for review.

—Alex
Director of Engineering, Nimbus Retail
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@nimblestore.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimblestore.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T12:25:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Nimbus — short-window burst pricing negotiation (approval request)

Laura / Rishi — looping you both in for pricing & billing approval. Nimbus is asking to: 
  - Reduce activation flat fee from $14,500 -> $9,500
  - Shorten commitment discount trigger from 3 months -> 2 months
  - Add explicit throttling fallback clause in the amendment (they want the wording so ops can prepare)

I recommended the 20% discount for a 3-month commit, but they proposed 15–20% for 2 months and a $9.5k activation. Can we approve a concession to $10,000 flat fee and 15% overage discount for a 2-month uplift commitment? If approved I will update the amendment and send DocuSign (Procurement wants PO + net-30).

Quoted below: 
> Alex Chen: 
> Can you reduce the flat activation fee to $9,500? That keeps the event within our campaign budget.
> If you can get close to the $9.5k activation fee and a 15–20% discount with a 2-month uplift commitment, we can route a PO quickly.

Ben
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Sofia Ramos <sofia.ramos@nimblestore.com>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@nimblestore.com>
Date: 2026-05-16T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Nimbus — short-window burst pricing negotiation (approval request)

Ben — okay to proceed with a concession but we should protect Redwood on operational risk. Approval notes: 
  - Accept $10,000 one-time activation fee (reduce from $14,500)
  - Approved 15% discount on post-window overage rate with a 2-month committed uplift to be formalized in the amendment
  - Add explicit throttling fallback language: Redwood will attempt best-effort scaled serving during excess beyond the burst window; if sustained excess persists for >30 minutes we will switch to graceful degradation (reduced token window, rate-limited responses) and notify Nimbus ops. This limits risk and is standard wording.
  - Procurement terms: PO + net-30 OK; billing to be managed by Finance (rishi) — please confirm invoicing contact and billing address.

Rishi — please confirm you can accept the net-30 PO and release the one-time activation invoice upon DocuSign execution. Ben — once Rishi confirms, please update the amendment and send DocuSign.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales Lead | Redwood Inference
